kind.description: `review` for a review session (s015), `session` otherwise. The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before s015 still type-checks.

board.description: Null when the session has no PR yet; the stage is then in `summary.session.stage`.

agents_running.description: Names of agents whose pi process the daemon currently hosts.

can_verify.description: True while the stack is up: the operator can test and tick `verify`.

diff.description: The diff viewers (s012). The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before s012 still type-checks.

cost.description: What the session's agents have spent (s013), from their transcripts. The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before s013 still type-checks.

review.description: The review facts (s015): set for a review session, and for an ordinary session once its swarm ran. Absent otherwise.

design.description: The design facts (docs/designs/egm-adoption.md, T7, T12). Absent for a session without a `design` block in `session.yaml`.

round.description: The round: `session.round`, else the `-r<n>` suffix of the branch, else 1. The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before the EGM design still type-checks.

rounds.description: The earlier rounds, oldest first; empty in round 1. The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before the EGM design still type-checks.

SessionView.description: Everything the UI renders for one session. `GET /sessions` returns one per session and `session.updated` carries a fresh one on every change, so the UI never polls.

path.description: Absolute path of the session directory.

SessionSummary.description: What the daemon reports about a session: the parsed file plus where it lives.

kind.description: `review` for a review session (s015); absent means an ordinary session.

title_pinned.description: True after the operator renamed the session (dogfood #27): the lead's `session_title` is refused until the operator unpins it. Absent means false.

project.description: Project name whose `spinner.yaml` configures the stack and the pipeline tracker.

needs_human.description: The single next action for the operator, or null.

round.description: Round number; 1 until the first `spinner reset`. Absent in files written before s005.

diff.description: The diff viewers the daemon runs for this session (s012). Absent before the first start.

review.description: The review swarm (s015). Absent until the first `review`.

design.description: Absent means a session from before the EGM design. `SESSION_VERSION` stays 1.

rounds.description: Earlier rounds, oldest first, appended by `reset` since the EGM design. Rounds before that are only in `## Previous rounds` of MISSION.md.

outcomes.description: Absent in sessions created before EGM build session 6.

SessionKind.description: What a session is (s015). `review` is a place for a peer's PR: a detached worktree at the PR head under `<home>/reviews/`, no project, no stack, and `review` as its one action.

path.description: Path of the repo on this machine. May start with `~` or be relative to the session.

worktree.description: Worktree path relative to the session directory. Absent for the bootstrap session.

changed.description: True when the session's branch has commits ahead of `base` in this repo.

pr.description: The PR for this repo, or null when none has been opened.

bot_reviewed_head.description: Head SHA of the latest bot review, or null before the first one.

queue_reason.description: Why the merge queue removed the PR, from `RemovedFromMergeQueueEvent.reason`.

last_activity.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last activity on the PR.

title.description: PR title, as `gh pr create` set it or GitHub reports it. Absent before s005.

checks_failing.description: Names of the checks that are red, for the CI pill's tooltip (s015). Absent before s015.

peer.description: Logins of peers who approved the current head.

owner.description: Whether the owner (the person named in `github.owner_login`) approved the current head.

flagged.description: Open threads the fixer flagged for the operator. Absent in files written before s005.

verified_heads.description: Repo name to head SHA that the operator verified.

verified_at.description: When and by whom `spinner verify` recorded the tick. Absent until the first tick.

posted_at.description: When `spinner post` sent the message. Absent until then.

approved_heads.description: Repo name to head SHA the operator approved through `spinner approve`.

slack_activity.description: Replies and reactions under the Slack post, as the daemon last polled them.

Pipeline.description: Pipeline facts. Hand-written files may omit `verified_heads` and `reviewer`; the daemon treats an absent field as empty and fills it in when it first writes the file.

last_activity.description: ISO 8601 time of the latest reply or reaction, or null when there is none.

polled_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the poll that produced these counts.

SlackActivity.description: What the daemon reads under the session's Slack post. Read-only; counts drive the board.

project.description: Docker compose project name, for example `spinner-s17`.

hosts.description: Service name to hostname, for example `admin` to `admin.s17.localhost`.

db.description: Database name cloned from the seed template.

db_stale.description: The clone belongs to a previous round: `reset` ran while the stack was down and did not touch the server. The next `up` drops it before it clones.

processes.description: Services with `runtime: host`, by name: the process Spinner started for them.

last_job.description: The last `up`, `down` or `reset` job, so an agent can see why a stack failed.

StackStateName.description: Stack state, as the daemon observes it. `none` means the session has no stack.

started.description: The process start time as `ps` prints it. A pid is reused once its process exits; the start time tells Spinner's process from a stranger that inherited the number.

port.description: The port the service listens on; the proxy routes its hostname here.

log.description: Log file, relative to the session directory.

HostProcess.description: A `runtime: host` service's process, as `spinner up` started it.

error.description: The error message of a failed job, else null.

tail.description: The last `STACK_JOB_TAIL_LINES` lines of the job's log.

StackLastJob.description: How the last stack job ended. Written by the daemon when the job finishes.

started.description: The process start time as `ps -o lstart=` prints it, so a restart can tell a reused pid.

repo.description: Repo key of `repos` whose worktree is the agent's cwd; the session dir when absent.

skills.description: Skill directories pi loads with `--skill`, beyond the session's `skills/` (s015).

AgentSpec.description: One agent of a session: how it runs and whether its process is alive.

AgentHarnessName.description: How an agent's pi runs: `tty` is pi's own terminal UI in a pty, rendered by the agent tab over `GET /sessions/:dir/agents/:name/tty`; `rpc` is `pi --mode rpc`, the headless path. `pi` is the value files written before s009 carry; it reads as `rpc`.

threads.description: The unresolved comment threads of every running viewer, from the watcher's last `diffview comments list --json`. The view counts them and the stage derivation turns the ones waiting on the operator into `needs_human`.

DiffState.description: One `diffview` process per repo, by repo key, while it runs. Reattached by pid identity.

path.description: The file, or null for a thread on the whole branch or on a description.

DiffThreadRecord.description: One unresolved thread, as much of it as `needs_human` and the tab's badge need.

draft.description: True while `artifacts/review-draft.json` exists (s016); the tracker reads it.

posted_url.description: The posted review's URL (s016), null until `post`.

ReviewState.description: The review swarm of a session (s015): the daemon writes it, `SessionView.review` reads it.

pr.description: Repo key of `repos` whose PR the reviewer reads.

error.description: Why the reviewer is `failed` (s016): the start error, the last text, or the exit code.

SwarmRecord.description: One reviewer of the swarm (s015), as `session.yaml` records it under `review.swarm`.

SwarmState.description: A reviewer's state (s015, s016). `done`: its verdict is in `artifacts/reviews/` and its pi is stopped. `failed`: it settled without a `VERDICT:` block, or exited.

needs.description: The derived `needs_human` text of the design stage, or null.

waiting.description: True when the lead settled on a question.

doc.description: Repo-relative path of the design doc; absent until the lead calls `design_doc`.

approvals.description: Every approval, oldest first; at most `DESIGN_APPROVALS_MAX`.

changed_after_approval.description: True when the doc changed after the approval: the approval is invalidated.

DesignState.description: The `design` block of `session.yaml`. `stage`, `needs` and `waiting` are derived.

DesignReviewRun.description: The review run that the app started (build session 3). Ids are `r1`, `r2`, …

DesignGate.description: An open gate: the one question the lead asked through `ask_question` (build session 3).

blockers.description: The blockers the newest report listed when the operator approved.

round.description: The session round the approval belongs to.

DesignApproval.description: One approval of the design doc. `sha256` is the normalized hash (T7).

started.description: ISO 8601 start and end of the round; null for a round read from MISSION.md.

RoundRecord.description: One earlier round of a session, as `reset` records it before it clears the PR facts.

RoundPr.description: One PR of an earlier round. `merged_at` is the PR's `last_activity` when merged, else null.

OutcomeCounts.description: The outcome counters (docs/designs/egm-adoption.md, 6.19 to 6.22): fixer rounds and the operator's steers to the lead, counted per session across rounds.

stale.description: True in peer-review when no reviewer activity happened for `stale_after_hours`.

prs.description: One entry per repo with a PR, in `session.yaml` order.

BoardView.description: The pipeline tracker's view of a session: the derived stage and the PR facts behind it.

NeedsHuman.description: The single next action for the operator, or null when nothing waits on them.

bot_reviewed_head.description: Head SHA of the latest bot review, or null before the first one.

queue_reason.description: Why the merge queue removed the PR, from `RemovedFromMergeQueueEvent.reason`.

last_activity.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last activity on the PR.

title.description: PR title, as `gh pr create` set it or GitHub reports it. Absent before s005.

checks_failing.description: Names of the checks that are red, for the CI pill's tooltip (s015). Absent before s015.

PrFacts.description: Facts about one PR, as stored in `session.yaml`, plus the repo key they belong to.

project.description: Docker compose project name, or null when the session has no stack.

database.description: Per-session database name, or null when the session has no stack.

services.description: Every service of the spec, in spec order. Empty when the session has no stack.

observed.description: ISO 8601 time of the last docker observation, or null before the first one.

last_job.description: The last `up`, `down` or `reset` job, or null before the first one. The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before s011 still type-checks.

usage.description: The last usage sample over the stack's services, or null when down or unsampled.

StackView.description: Stack state assembled from `session.yaml` and the daemon's last docker observation.

host.description: `<host>.<id>.localhost`, or null for an internal service.

url.description: Full URL of the service through the proxy, or null for an internal service.

process.description: For `where: host`: the process `spinner up` started, while the stack is up.

preview.description: `services.<name>.preview` of the spec, `frame` when the spec leaves it out.

usage.description: The last usage sample for this service, or null when the stack is down or unsampled.

ServiceStatus.description: A service's health as the daemon last observed it. `unknown` is a service with no healthcheck that is running; `stopped` covers a stack that is down or a missing container.

PreviewMode.description: How the UI embeds the service's preview. `frame` (the default) is an iframe. `top-level` marks an app that needs its own top-level page, for example one whose login cookie is `SameSite=Lax`: the desktop app shows it in a `WebContentsView`, and the browser UI keeps the iframe but tells the operator to open it in a tab.

mem_limit_bytes.description: The limit `docker stats` prints: the container's own, or the engine's memory (Docker Desktop's VM) for a container without one. Absent for a host service.

net_rx_bytes.description: Network and block I/O totals since the container started; containers only.

ServiceUsage.description: What one service takes of the machine, from `docker stats` for a container and from `ps` (the process and its descendants) for a host service. Bytes for memory and I/O, and cpu as a percentage of one core, as docker and ps report it (200 means two cores busy).

StackUsage.description: The sum over a stack's services, from one sample.

available.description: True once `fetch` is `ready`: viewers can start and the tools work.

fetch_error.description: Why the last fetch failed, else null.

repos.description: One entry per repo of `session.yaml`, in `repos` order, running or not.

DiffFetchState.description: Whether the viewer's sources are on this machine. `absent` before the first start, `fetching` while the job runs, `ready` once `diffview --help` answers from the checkout, `failed` with `fetch_error` set. A failed fetch runs again on the next start.

url.description: `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/`, or null when not running. The viewer refuses every other Host, so the UI embeds this URL directly; it never goes through the Spinner proxy.

pid.description: The viewer's pid while it runs, else null.

error.description: Why the last start failed, else null.

DiffViewerState.description: A viewer's state. `stopped` is the rest state: no process, `url` null. `starting` is between spawn and the first answer on `GET /`. `failed` keeps `error` from the exit or the timeout; `start` clears it.

DiffWaiting.description: How many threads wait on each side, from the last `diffview comments list --json`.

agents.description: Each agent's own rows; a Goldfish's rows are under `children`, not under the lead.

children.description: Each Goldfish step's sum, keyed `"<runId>/<step index>"`. Absent without one.

SessionCost.description: `SessionView.cost`: the session's agents summed, and each agent's share.

model.description: The model of the agent's latest assistant message, or null before its first.

context.description: How full the agent's context window is (dogfood #45), from its latest assistant message and that model's window. Null before the first message or while the window of the model is unknown (the daemon's model list is not loaded, or pi does not know the model). Optional so a fixture written before round 4 still type-checks; the daemon always sets it on `SessionView.cost.agents`.

tokens.description: `input + cacheRead + cacheWrite` of the latest assistant message's usage.

window.description: The model's `contextWindow` from `pi --list-models`, in tokens; above 0.

pct.description: `tokens / window` as a whole percent, rounded down; can pass 100 after a model change.

AgentContext.description: The context use of one agent: the prompt of its latest message against the window.

checks.description: The PR's checks, rolled up, and the names of the failing ones.

threads.description: The PR's review threads, open and resolved.

draft.description: The lead's draft (s016); null before it is written and after `drop` or `post`.

posted_url.description: The posted review's URL (s016), null until `post`.

state.description: The daemon always sets the next three; optional so an older fixture type-checks.

comment_count.description: Line comments in the draft; 0 without one.

event.description: The draft's event (`APPROVE` when the lead found nothing); null without a draft.

ReviewFields.description: The review fields of a `SessionView` (s015, s016); the `review.updated` payload.

pr.description: Repo key of the PR the reviewer reads.

error.description: Why a `failed` reviewer failed (s016), truncated; null in the other states. The daemon always sets it; optional so a fixture written before s016 still type-checks.

SwarmMember.description: One reviewer of the swarm, as the chips show it: a tty agent of the session.

body.description: The summary only; the line comments are not repeated here.

ReviewDraft.description: The lead's draft, `artifacts/review-draft.json` (s016): the operator edits it, then posts.

ReviewEvent.description: The review events of a PR review, as GitHub names them (s016).

ReviewDraftComment.description: One line comment of the draft: the file, the line on the right side of the diff, the body.

ReviewProgress.description: Where a review stands (s016): `drafted` while a draft exists; else `reviewing` while a reviewer is `queued` or `reading` or the lead runs a turn; else `posted` once a review went up; else `idle`.

repo.description: The repo key of the doc, else of the designs repo; null without one. Optional, so a fixture written before build session 3 still type-checks; the daemon always sets it.

designs_dir.description: The absolute designs directory (`spinner.yaml` `designs`, T7), the one `.state.json` carries; null when the designs repo has no worktree. Optional, as `repo`.

DesignView.description: The design facts of a `SessionView`. `stage` is null outside the design track. `reviews`, `consolidated` and `resolve` describe the current review run. Until build session 4, `goldfish` is `[]`, `goldfish_live` is 0 and `cost_by_stage` is `{}`.

GoldfishView.description: One Goldfish run of the lead. Build session 4 fills these.

started.description: ISO 8601 start and end of the round; null for a round read from MISSION.md.

RoundView.description: One earlier round. `record` comes from `session.yaml` `rounds`; `mission` is read from a `### Round` heading of MISSION.md, with `url`, `merged_at`, `started` and `ended` null.
